content.value: . An engine requires 5 kg of air per minute from its carburator. The air is at a pressure of 1.05 bar and a temperature of 25 °C. Determine the throat diameter of the venturi when the air-flow velocity at the throat is 1.02 m/s with a velocity coefficient of 0.8. Assume isentropic flow and consider air as compressible.
